body:
Found reviewing #802 (present before it; the rebuild in #802 only carries it forward). In UNIFIED_INGREDIENT_MAPPING.tsv, 'Na2HPO4·7H2O' and 'K2HPO4 x 3H2O' carry the anhydrous CHEBI ids. That is a hydrate→anhydrous identity collapse, which MAPPING_SEMANTICS forbids. Needs tracing to whether the claw builder or the MIM records supply those ids.

---
**Traced:** the claw builder ranked a recipe's own `term.id` above MIM's ruling on the label. Fix in progress: CultureBotAI/culturebotai-claw#571 resolves through MIM's label index first, which fixes `K2HPO4 x 3H2O`'s `mim_id` and about 58 other hydrate labels. Still open after it: (a) the `chebi_id` column keeps the recipe's anhydrous CHEBI term when MIM's identity is a non-CHEBI mint (a deliberate `_published_ids` rule; kg-microbe#723 / #138); (b) `Na2HPO4·7H2O` has no label-index row (#811).

The user approved replacing PR #914 from current main with its five specified non-merge commits, excluding the Claw-pin hunks. This step restores the nine explicit tombstone representatives, retains reviewed form-specific rejection-ledger decisions, and regenerates exports, indexes, unified snapshot/provenance and the native current review.

Acceptance: zero REJECTED unified rows with an empty mim_id; zero kgmicrobe.compound unified rows carrying CHEBI; all nine tombstones have representative. Full native QC, receipt-chain validation and independent final-head adversarial review precede a squash merge through the queue. The old #914 branch is not rewritten; the PR will be closed with its replacement pointer only after the replacement merges.

Approved plan SHA256: `99b7746742f70c7896ed163a833a8b214282dba84567dc3213ec0a2b194e4d90`. Related: #869, #882, #894, #808.

title: Unified mapping maps hydrate source labels to anhydrous CHEBI terms (Na2HPO4·7H2O, K2HPO4 x 3H2O)
